## CITY OF CORAL GABLES, FLORIDA

## RESOLUTION NO. 2024-47

A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COMMISISON AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE OF MODIFICATION NO.  5 OF GRANT FUNDS TO AGREEMENT NO. G22MI0016A FUNDS IN THE AMOUNT OF $ 64,362.18 ON BEHALF OF THE CORAL GABLES POLICE DEPARTMENT AS PART OF THE OFFICE OF NATIONAL DRUG CONTROL POLICY ( ONDCP)  HIGH INTENSITY DRUG TRAFFICKING AREAS (HIDTA) PROGRAM TO SUPPORT FISCAL YEAR 20232024 OPERATIONS OF THE SOUTH FLORIDA MONEY LAUNDERING STRIKE FORCE;  AND AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 20232024 ANNUAL BUDGET TO RECOGNIZE THE $ 64,362.18 GRANT MODIFICATION NO.  5 AS REVENUE AND TO APPRO-  PRIATE SUCH FUNDS TO PUT TOWARD THE COST OF THE PROGRAM.

WHEREAS,  the Office of National Drug Control Policy' s ( ONDCP)  High Intensity Drug Trafficking Areas ( HIDTA)  program provides assistance to federal,  state and local law enforcement agencies in areas determined to be critical drug- trafficking regions of the United States;  and

WHEREAS,  the purpose of this program is to combat the threat from drug trafficking regions such as South Florida;  and

WHEREAS, the Coral Gables Police Department is the established local law enforcement agency for the provision of law enforcement services within the jurisdictional boundaries of the City of Coral Gables;  and

WHEREAS, through this grant program,  the Coral Gables Police Department is a subrecipient of allocated funds in the amount of $64,362.18 to support Fiscal Year 2023-2024 operations of the South Florida Money Laundering Strike Force; and

WHEREAS,  as a sub-recipient,  the City of Coral Gables will implement the grant funded initiative in accordance with all requirements provide by the HIDTA Program; and

WHEREAS, an amendment to the Fiscal Year 2023-2024 Annual Budget is required to recognize the $ 64,362.18 grant as revenue and to appropriate such funds to cover the grant ex penditure; and

Page 1 of 2 - Resolution No. 2024- 47

WHEREAS, staff recommends the Commission authorizes annual budget amendments, as needed,  for the life of the program;

## NOW, THEREFORE,  BE IT RESOLVED BY THE COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF CORAL GABLES:

SECTION 1.  That the foregoing ' WHEREAS'  clauses are hereby ratified and con-  firmed as being true and correct and are hereby made a specific part of this Resolution upon the adoption herein.

SECTION 2.  That the City Commission does hereby authorize acceptance of the modification of grant funds in the amount of $ 64,362.18 towards combating the threat from drug trafficking in the South Florida region.

SECTION 3.  That the City Commission authorizes the execution of the modification of grant funds contract with the Office of National Drug Control Policy (ONDCP).

SECTION 4. That the City Commission does hereby authorize an amendment to the Fiscal Year 2023-2024 annual budget to recognize the $64,362.18 grant as revenue and appropriating such funds to put toward the cost of the program;  as well as annual budget amendments,  as needed,  for the life of the program.

SECTION 5.  That this Resolution shall become effective upon the date of its passage and adoption herein.

PASSED AND ADOPTED THIS TWELFTH DAY OF MARCH A.D., 2024.

Moved: Fernandez / Seconded:  Anderson)

Unanimous Voice Vote)

Agenda Item: D-3)
